revisions.title: Boot-mode status surface: read /run/nuxel-bootmode.json in Settings and the Home status surface
intended_changes: the Settings app (and/or the Home status surface) loads /run/nuxel-bootmode.json and, when mode != "normal", renders the headline + message with touch_available as a tri-state (true | false | unknown) and the action ("unplug-and-normal-reboot"); when mode == "normal" nothing is shown
the same reader exposes the machine line from /run/nuxel-bootmode.state (BOOTMODE= / TOUCH_AVAILABLE=) so Settings and the live console agree
tests: a unit test that feeds a charger-mode /run/nuxel-bootmode.json (touch_available=false) and asserts the banner text + tri-state, and a normal-mode fixture asserting no banner
read once at start-up plus on the existing launcher refresh - no busy polling
revisions.rollback: git revert the commit(s) touching pwa/nuxel-apps/settings, shell/nuxel-shell/nuxel-settings and pwa/nuxel-home; the reader is read-only and changes no device state
revisions.owner_action: boot into charger mode (or a normal boot) and confirm the owner actually sees/does not see the warning on screen; until then this surface is NEEDS_OWNER_TEST
revisions.note: Recorded by bg-01-touch-pipeline while repairing briq-01c. The guard half is done (machine-readable NX_STATUS line, /run/nuxel-bootmode.state, and the /run/nuxel-bootmode.json launcher contract with mode/touch_available/message/action/graded) - see configs/nuxel/bootmode/README.md and docs/beta-finalization/touch/CHARGER-MODE-ROOTCAUSE.md. The RENDERING half is deliberately NOT implemented by bg-01: a grep over pwa/, services/ and shell/ finds no consumer of nuxel-bootmode, and the Settings/launcher surfaces belong to bg-06/bg-02, so this task is the explicit dependency that carries it so it cannot be lost. The split is documented in configs/nuxel/bootmode/README.md.
